source_refs.note: 'Connecting Conclusions to Hypotheses' under topic 7.7, as printed (PDF 103, printed 99).

blocks.text: Conclusions must be directly linked to the original hypotheses. Researchers should clearly state whether the hypothesis is supported or not. Data and test results should justify the conclusion. Personal opinions should not influence the final conclusion. Clear connections strengthen the validity of research. This step ensures logical consistency in the study. Connecting conclusions to hypotheses completes the research process effectively.
